blocks.text: Design Progress Report: Esparza-Lamb Site Grading
Where the work stands
The Esparza-Lamb site grading design is nearly finished. The full plan set is in final check, and the drawings are ready to be sealed and issued once one item from your office is confirmed.

The set covers the grading, roadway, storm drainage, and utility design for the site, on the sheets we agreed at the start: cover, existing conditions, grading, roadway plan and profile, drainage, utilities, erosion control, and details. All of those sheets are drafted.
The design work this period stayed within the design fee of {{fact:f:E-2001-001.fee}}. We do not expect any change to that figure between now and issue of the sealed set.
Completed this period
Since the last report the set moved from working drawings to a checked, near-final plan set. The remaining work is verification, not design.

The grading plan is final. Cut and fill were balanced across the site so the earthwork stays close to neutral, the earthwork quantities were recomputed from the final surface, and the quantity table on the grading sheet now matches the design memorandum that governs it. Spot elevations at the building pads, the drive entrances, and the low points were checked against the profiles.

The roadway plan and profile and the typical sections are done and checked. Stationing, centerline grades, and the pavement section were verified against the memorandum, the vertical curves meet the standard we designed to, and the profile ties to the existing edge of pavement at both ends of the connection.

The storm drainage design is complete. Pipe sizes, inlet locations, and inlet spacing are set, the runs were checked for cover and for minimum slope, and the detention basin grading and outlet are final. The drainage area map was redrawn to match the final grading, and the storm structure schedule was rebuilt from the final layout.

The water and sanitary sewer layout was coordinated with the grading so that cover over the mains and separation between them hold along the road. The erosion and sediment control sheet was drafted to the county standard details, with the construction entrance, silt fence, and inlet protection shown.

Jason Jordan brought the standard details and the border sheets current and reconciled the sheet index against the set. He caught two contour labels that no longer matched the revised grading and a drainage detail that still called an older pipe material, and both were corrected on the sheets.

A half-size check set of the grading, roadway, and drainage sheets is enclosed with this report for your file. It is a progress print for review only and is not for construction; the sealed set will follow on issue.
Still to do
A final quality check is in progress, and it is the last design task before issue.

Linda Nguyen is comparing every sheet in the set to the memorandum that controls it and confirming the match line callouts, the revision blocks, and the title blocks; Jason Jordan is checking the details and the callouts that point to them. The lettered project folder was brought current so the checked set, the memoranda, and the markups sit together.

We also reconciled the design against the current survey and the architectural site plan so the grading, the building pads, and the drive locations agree with the layout you last sent. Where the two disagreed, we held the survey for existing grade and the site plan for the building footprint, and noted each place on the sheet.
After the check, the one open item from your office is incorporated, and the set is sealed and issued. No other design work remains on our side.
Open item

One confirmation from your office is holding issue: the finished floor elevation for the corner building, which the entrance drive grading is tied to. We drafted the entrance grading to the elevation shown on the architectural site plan and flagged it on the grading sheet as to be confirmed.
Please confirm that elevation, or send the corrected value. If it changes, the change is limited to the entrance drive and the spot grades next to it, and we can turn it in a day.
Schedule and budget
The set is ready to issue on your confirmation. The elevation above is the only item on the schedule; with it confirmed, the sealed set follows the final check.
The work remains within the design fee, and we hold to {{fact:f:E-2001-001.fee}} through issue. We will contact your office if the final check turns up anything that affects the design or the fee.
That is the full status for this period. The design is complete but for the final check and the one confirmation, and the set will issue as soon as both are done.
